_comment: Storage layout snapshot for poker-table contract (issue #566). This file is the canonical list of Soroban storage keys. Any addition, removal, or rename of a DataKey variant is a potential storage collision and must update this file explicitly. CI fails when the source DataKey enum diverges from this snapshot. Run `python3 scripts/check_storage_layout.py --update` to regenerate after an intentional layout change.
_policy: Append-only: new variants may only be appended. Never remove or rename an existing variant; never change a variant's payload arity or storage domain without a migration.
